values.website: A rugged, fanless SD-WAN edge appliance powered by Intel X7425E, designed for high-performance networking at distributed sites. It combines multi-WAN connectivity (Ethernet, 4G/5G, Wi-Fi) with flexible OS support and industrial-grade reliability, making it ideal for seamless failover, traffic optimisation, and edge computing. Best suited for telecom, industrial IoT, smart infrastructure, and enterprise branch deployments.
values.catalogue: A rugged, fanless SD-WAN edge appliance powered by Intel X7425E, designed for high-performance networking at distributed sites. It combines multi-WAN connectivity (Ethernet, 4G/5G, Wi-Fi) with flexible OS support and industrial-grade reliability, making it ideal for seamless failover, traffic optimisation, and edge computing. Best suited for telecom, industrial IoT, smart infrastructure, and enterprise branch deployments.

values.website:
Enterprise Branch Connectivity

values.catalogue:
Enterprise Branch Connectivity — Provides secure and uninterrupted connectivity for branch offices with multi-WAN support (SD-WAN), enabling seamless failover and optimized network performance.
Infotainment System for Vehicles — The Intel X7425E platform enables advanced vehicle infotainment, telematics, and connectivity solutions. It supports GPS navigation, multimedia applications, 4G/5G communication, Wi-Fi hotspot functionality, and real-time vehicle monitoring, making it ideal for connected vehicles, fleet management, and smart transportation systems.
